wholePhysicalScope: Mapped 14-point dam outline from way 323624579, including six shared shoreline points with the named Intermediate Reservoir. The government 5 m terrain records the narrow drop below the dam and the adjoining banks.
lodDetails: All detail levels retain the north spillway, masonry wall, shoulders and stilling pool. Near levels refine the basin rails and downstream profile.
limitations: The published reservoir full water elevation of 58.17 m HKPD was used as the approximate lowered overflow height. The 1977 safety works lowered the north spillway by nine feet. The exact location and lengths of these crest changes are estimates.

The basin edge, depth and guardrails are interpreted from the local grade and written records. No dated water surface is represented. The valve house and its access bridge are reserved for the independent valve-house model.
